Locators are printed page numbers, which equal PDF pages. The held PDF has no title page: the report number comes from the page footers and PDF metadata, the first author from the metadata, the co-authors from the citation in to-get.csv (matches refs [7], [8]). Laboratory development of a combined Co-zeolite DeNOx + Fe-zeolite DeN2O catalyst with propane/LPG reductant, plus an Emission Care techno-economic study (Ch. 5) on an average Dutch nitric acid plant tail gas (200,000 Nm3/h, 1500 ppmv N2O, 500 ppmv NOx). Main file: atmospheric and high-pressure combined systems and the reference (NH3-DeNOx + LPG-DeN2O): investment (absolute, M EUR), capacity as tail gas flow, 90% N2O reduction, abatement cost per t CO2-eq, 7% discount rate; and literature abatement-cost ranges for secondary and tertiary decomposition and HC-SCR (reprinted). Flows: LPG and ammonia per t N2O abated (derived from annual totals). Other-values: annual cost, cost per kg NOx/N2O, production loss, pressure drop, annual reductions. Not loaded: catalyst test curves (charts), kinetic model, NOx-only DeNOx costs. Traps: no nitric acid capacity is printed, so nothing is per t acid; the annual cost includes capital recovery and reductant, so it is not a fixed O&M; no price year printed (2002 used; UKERC evidently treated it as 2001).
